title: wg: mlswg passive-client vectors have expired leaf lifetimes
description: Suggestion to mlswg/mls-implementations (commit 2034fe72). Suite-1 passive-client-welcome.json leaf lifetimes end 2024-03-02 (visible in the vector). passive-client-handling-commit.json KeyPackages use (0, 2^64-1), but its group ratchet trees are inside the encrypted Welcome and OpenMLS PublicGroup fails all 13 suite-1 cases with LeafNodeValidation(Lifetime(Expired)) when built from them (mimid-1wgh.4.6). RFC 9420 §7.3 only RECOMMENDS checking received leaves, but implementations that check cannot run the vectors. mimid patched OpenMLS to skip (decision mimid-1wgh.4.38). Fix: regenerate with not_after = 2^64-1, or document that verifiers must skip lifetime checks.
